name: 바위 골렘
creator: colorsocks
design: a compact ordinary rock golem built from a few large rounded gray stone blocks: head sunk directly into one squat torso, TWO short chunky arms with mitten-like rock fists, TWO stubby feet. Small simple cyan rectangular eyes on the RIGHT side of the head. One flat moss-green patch on upper head and one shoulder. Four flat colors. No neck, no cracks, no gravel, no runes, no crystal clusters, no armor, no extra rock layers. Simple mass-produced low-rank enemy, not a giant boss. Whole body faces RIGHT in three-quarter side view, hands close to torso.
